question: Find the forename and surname of the driver who had the slowest third-lap time (as recorded in lapTimes) in any race held at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, among drivers born after 1975 who have ever achieved a fastest-lap rank of 2 in any race.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039"
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN races AS r ON lt."XCL_043" = r."XCL_065"
JOIN circuits AS c ON r."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
JOIN drivers AS d ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND lt."XCL_045" = 3
  AND d."XCL_040" > '1975-12-31'
  AND d."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT res."XCL_075"
    FROM results AS res
    WHERE res."XCL_087" = 2
  )
ORDER BY lt."XCL_048" DESC
LIMIT 1

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.
Lap time recorded in the second qualifying session (Q2). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q1, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q1 times.
Lap time recorded in the third qualifying session (Q3). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q2, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q2 times.

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.

measures.multiplicity_argument: Each lapTimes row is one lap observation; ordering one row per lap avoids multiplying driver identity.

FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN races AS r ON lt."XCL_043" = r."XCL_065"
JOIN circuits AS c ON r."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"

ORDER BY lt."XCL_048" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039"
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN races AS r ON lt."XCL_043" = r."XCL_065"
JOIN circuits AS c ON r."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
JOIN drivers AS d ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND lt."XCL_045" = 3
  AND d."XCL_040" > '1975-12-31'
  AND d."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT res."XCL_075"
    FROM results AS res
    WHERE res."XCL_087" = 2
  )
ORDER BY lt."XCL_048" DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039"
FROM circuits c
INNER JOIN races r ON c."XCL_001" = r."XCL_068"
INNER JOIN lapTimes lt ON r."XCL_065" = lt."XCL_043"
INNER JOIN drivers d ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND lt."XCL_045" = 3
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', d."XCL_040") > '1975'
  AND d."XCL_034" IN (SELECT res."XCL_075" FROM results res WHERE res."XCL_085" = 2)
ORDER BY lt."XCL_046" DESC
LIMIT 1
